items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: So I met Bill Hardman, you know. And he said "here man, I'm sure glad you're in the band."

ctx.x: And I'm saying this shit to myself, man. So I met Bill Hardman, you know. And he said "here man, I'm sure glad you're in the band." And I said "I'm glad too, man, because all the bands I've been in have been like grown--I'm the youngest dude in the band, you know."
